title_working: Grandma Pays Me To Eat Vegetables. Grandpa Pays Me Not To.
world_rule: Grandma Pays Me To Eat Vegetables. Grandpa Pays Me Not To.

lines.text: Grandma pays me a dollar for every vegetable I eat. Grandpa pays me two dollars not to.
lines.say: (confident) Grandma pays me a dollar for every vegetable I eat. Grandpa pays me two dollars not to.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: So every dinner at their house is a war.
lines.say: (happy) So every dinner at their house is a war.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Grandma hides broccoli in my pasta. Grandpa slips me cash under the table.
lines.say: (happy) Grandma hides broccoli in my pasta. Grandpa slips me cash under the table.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Grandma says, eat your carrots, sweetie. Grandpa whispers, don't you dare.
lines.say: (happy) Grandma says, eat your carrots, sweetie. Grandpa whispers, don't you dare.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: By Friday, I had forty dollars and a very confused stomach.
lines.say: (nervous) By Friday, I had forty dollars and a very confused stomach.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then, looking for cookies, I found their secret notebook under the cookie jar.
lines.say: (serious) Then, looking for cookies, I found their secret notebook under the cookie jar.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: It had two columns. One said Grandma. One said Grandpa.
lines.say: (serious) It had two columns. One said Grandma. One said Grandpa.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Under each, the same words again and again. He came. He came. He came.
lines.say: (soft tone) Under each, the same words again and again. He came. He came. He came.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Every single night had two check marks.
lines.say: (soft tone) Every single night had two check marks.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: That's when I remembered. Before the vegetable war, I only visited them on holidays.
lines.say: (sad) That's when I remembered. Before the vegetable war, I only visited them on holidays.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Grandpa had stopped working. Grandma's friends had moved away. Their house was quiet every night.
lines.say: (sad) Grandpa had stopped working. Grandma's friends had moved away. Their house was quiet every night.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: So they made up a game. A war I could only win by coming back every night.
lines.say: (soft tone) So they made up a game. A war I could only win by coming back every night.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: It was never about the vegetables. It was about me.
lines.say: (sad) It was never about the vegetables. It was about me.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: That night, I ate all my broccoli. Then I gave Grandpa his forty dollars back.
lines.say: (happy) That night, I ate all my broccoli. Then I gave Grandpa his forty dollars back.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I told them, you don't have to pay me. I'll come anyway.
lines.say: (soft tone) I told them, you don't have to pay me. I'll come anyway.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Grandma started crying. Grandpa pretended he wasn't.
lines.say: (sad) Grandma started crying. Grandpa pretended he wasn't.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then he leaned in and whispered, Same time tomorrow? Three dollars.
lines.say: (happy) Then he leaned in and whispered, Same time tomorrow? Three dollars.
